perspective:
Christian’s available information:

- He is a police officer and has been close friends with Jonathan Balogun since childhood; Jonathan is his best friend, someone he seeks advice from, and he knows Jonathan is more educated/has a master’s degree.
- He noticed Jonathan acting differently and felt anxious/suspicious that Jonathan was hiding something important. He arranged a meeting at their favorite coffee shop.
- At the meeting, Christian confronted Jonathan. Jonathan first said Christian could trust him, then admitted he had been keeping something: Jonathan is in trouble and did not know how to tell Christian.
- Christian felt worried and empathetic, offered help, and heard Jonathan say the situation is complicated and he did not want to drag Christian in. Christian insisted they face it together as best friends. Jonathan said he could use support/resources and needed to figure a way out of the mess.
- Christian began to believe the trouble might involve criminal activity. He asked Jonathan if it was illegal. He heard Jonathan say he could not be sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but did not do anything illegal himself. Christian said he would look into it discreetly; Jonathan thanked him and trusted him to handle it carefully.
- Through his own investigation, Christian learned/believes Jonathan is being framed and someone is trying to set him up. He had some leads but did not yet know who. He told Jonathan he believed Jonathan was being framed and that he would gather more evidence to prove his innocence. Jonathan was surprised and asked who; Christian said he was not sure yet.
- Later, Christian came to believe/he found out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan—someone they both know and trust. He felt betrayed and resolved to confront this person and bring them to justice. He told Jonathan he had found out who was behind it, that it was someone they both know and trust, and that he would confront them. Jonathan warned him the person is dangerous but said he trusted Christian.
